@graph.name: Ingestion Program
@graph.description: Loads input data, splits it into train/test, and supplies them to the code submissions for training and predictions. Saves predictions and ground truth to result submission.

@graph.name: Input Data — Meta-Album INS Micro
@graph.description: Preprocessed insect dataset derived from the original National Museum of Natural History (Paris) collection. Images resized to 128x128 using OpenCV.

@graph.name: Sample Code Submission — Insects Classification Task Solution
@graph.description: The sample code submission has an example model that trains on the train set and predicts on the test set. NOTE: This submission is a sample solution for this task, In a competition this part is missing and participants are supposed to provide their own models/submissions to test their models using this task and get a good rank on the leaderboard.

@graph.name: Scoring Program
@graph.description: Computes Balanced Accuracy and F1 Score from predictions and ground truth, saving results to `scores.json`.

@graph.name: Ingestion Output - Predictions and Ground Truth
@graph.description: Ingestion output consists of two files predictions.txt and ground_truth.txt.

@graph.name: Scoring Output
@graph.description: A scores.json is the output of this task that shows f1-score and balanced accuracy score

@graph.name: Execution Requirements to run this task
@graph.description: Task can be run in a Python environment or containerized environment with Python 3+.

cr:TaskProblem.name: Insects Classification
cr:TaskProblem.description: This Insect Classification task uses the micro version of the Meta-Album INS dataset. The goal is to classify insects into different classes/categories. Submitted models are given a train set for training and a test set for predictions. Predictions are saved along with the test ground truth. During evaluation, Balanced Accuracy and F1 scores are computed. This task is implemented using the required format of Codabaench. It consists of an ingestion program, and evaluating/scoring program and input data. A code submission (classification model) is required to run the task.

cr:implementation.name: Task Implementation: Ingestion program implementation
cr:implementation.description: Implementation of the task ingestion program

cr:evaluation.name: Insects Classification Evaluation
cr:evaluation.description: Evaluation uses Balanced Accuracy and F1 Score metrics computed from the scoring program.
